items.title: 🎯 Differentiate GitHub API Failures from Missing Webhooks to Prevent Erroneous Reconciliation
items.content:
## 📝 Description
When querying the GitHub API to check for the existence or status of repository webhooks, non-404 API failures (such as HTTP 429 Rate Limits, 5xx Server Errors, network timeouts, or 401/403 Authentication/Authorization issues) are incorrectly interpreted as the webhook being absent.
